iteration: v120 — EAGLE-3 trace-compatible verify on Qwen3-8B, 2×P150a

changes.verify_trace: SGLANG_TT_VERIFY_TRACE=1 (default on) enables enable_trace=True in verify decode loop
changes.trace_invalidation: Aux-wrapper install invalidates existing decode trace so recapture includes ttnn.clone() ops
changes.prefetcher_mux: generate_mux_safe_sender_receiver_mapping() for Blackhole MUX grid (12x8); is_blackhole() detection; max_row=7 hardcoded
changes.prefill_chunk_size: Qwen3-1.7B: 128, Qwen3-8B: 64 added to MAX_PREFILL_CHUNK_SIZE table

qwen3_1_7B_no_spec.note: SGLang overhead is 1.9% — bottleneck is 100% tt-metal decode

qwen3_8B_eagle3_no_trace.note: Previous baseline with enable_trace=False in verify

qwen3_8B_eagle3_with_trace.note: Trace replay partially helps but CPU draft model dominates verify cycle time

blockers.prefetcher_l1_clash: DRAM prefetcher's global CB clashes with RMSNorm op L1 allocation on receiver/worker cores. MUX clamp fixed (row 9 → 5), but L1 coordination needs tt-metal sub_device API changes.
blockers.reads_during_trace_capture: TT_FATAL during first aux-capture trace: 'Reads are not supported during trace capture'. Non-fatal — server continues and subsequent replays work.
blockers.eagle_verify_throughput: 9.8 tok/s with trace is still 2.8× slower than no-spec baseline. Root cause: 2 decode calls per verify cycle + CPU draft model latency + prefill-for-verify overhead.
blockers.path_a_single_prefill_verify: Collapsing to 1 decode per verify cycle requires tt-metal's prefill_forward_text to return per-position logits (currently slices to last token only).

tt_perf_reference.gap_analysis: 21ms actual vs 16.5ms expected = 27% gap, likely from missing DRAM prefetcher
